## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, what changes, and why it helps. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. State what was not tested. Clearly distinguish offline simulations from separately authorized live checks. Do not include credentials, account identifiers, private paths, customer data, or raw provider responses.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe any effect on permissions, write safeguards, spending limits, credential handling, audit records, or existing configurations. State whether runtime behavior changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and I have the right to contribute it under the project's MIT license.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures and untested areas are explained above.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic data and preserve protections against real provider access.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior changes where applicable.
- [ ] The changes and attachments contain no credentials or private account data.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md in the project root instead of opening a public pull request.
